subject: math

hotspots.label: Fraction
hotspots.description: The pizza models how a whole splits into equal parts — shown as a fraction like 3/4.
hotspots.positionHint: The round pizza on the mat with equal slices, some lifted away.
hotspots.function: Shows part of a whole as a fraction.

hotspots.label: Numerator
hotspots.description: The numerator (top) counts the parts you have — the 3 lifted slices.
hotspots.positionHint: The number plate showing '3' above the fraction bar.
hotspots.function: Counts the parts taken of a fraction.

hotspots.label: Denominator
hotspots.description: The denominator (bottom) counts the equal parts the whole is split into — the 4 slices.
hotspots.positionHint: The number plate showing '4' below the fraction bar.
hotspots.function: Counts the equal parts in a whole.

visualStyleNotes: Fractions And Ratios shares the Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A round pizza on a plain mat with some slices lifted and stacked, a slice-count slider, and a fraction plate. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / coral / molecular-green from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Pizza: warm paper-toned disc (roughness ~0.5) with a soft toast-crust ring and faint seam lines for slices. Lifted slices: a few plates floating above the pizza, same material. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). Fraction plate: warm paper with ink '3/4' text. Slider: soft warm-grey rail with amber knob. No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: a fraction as equal parts of a whole, modeled with a pizza — a round whole, a divider that cuts equal slices, lifted slice pieces, and a live fraction readout.

GEOMETRY: Pizza: flat cylinder (radius ~1.0, thickness ~0.12) centered at origin, y ≈ 0.15, on a round mat. Slices are baked as wedge seams. A Divider slider updates the count of equal slices (2..8). Lifted slices: small wedge pieces hover above (y ≈ 0.4) showing how many parts are 'taken'. Fraction plate: a floating panel at the front-right reading 'numerator/denominator' that updates live.

INTERACTION: a SliceCount slider (2,3,4,5,6,8) rebuilds seams maintaining equality; a Take slider lifts 0..n slices. All wedges stay equal size for any slice count.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) whole + seams; (2) lifted slices; (3) fraction plate + numerator/denominator labels.

CAMERA: head-on from +z slightly high frames the pizza and plate; calm, minimal chrome. Budget 7-12k triangles. Named nodes: Pizza_Whole, SliceSeams, LiftedSlices, Mat, Slider_Knob, FractionPlate, NumeratorBadge, DenominatorBadge. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
